name: Per-hop RTT, capacity, interference, recovery
description: Once the network is formed and stable: per-hop RTT baseline; capacity search until the RTT p95 doubles, the largest RTT reaches 5 s or the delivery falls below 95 %; 80 % of that capacity, first 120 s without interferer as the reference, then with an interferer on half of the channels; recovery after removing it, until the RTT p95 is back within 1.2 x the reference's.
